prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Companion is Active on Desktop", "Use the system tray icon to hide, summon, or talk with your pet anytime.", "Desktop Quick Controls"]
1: ["Verify Photo Framing", "Ensure your photo has clear lighting and framing for the best pet generation.", "Confirm & Generate"]
2: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Companion", "Linking your account ensures your companion traits and customizations stay saved.", "Your companion stays permanently linked to this account.", "Cloud Save & Reset Safeguard Active"]
3: ["Setting Up Desktop Companion", "Preparing desktop overlays, tray shortcuts, and background pet animation pipelines.", "Checking desktop system tray permission"]
4: ["Welcome Your Companion", "Click your system tray icon to hide or reveal your pet. Right-click to open controls or chat."]
5: ["When setup completes, look for your companion icon in the system tray near your clock."]
6: ["Desktop Pet Tips"]
7: ["You can change paths or adopt additional pets anytime in settings."]
8: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Use a clear photo with good lighting for optimal companion 3D generation.", "High Lighting Recommended"]
9: ["Select Companion Base Style", "Choose your favorite companion style to begin customization."]
